title: Looking to Hire someone for Frappe Helpdesk

posts.name: Neeraj Agarwal
posts.cooked:
I already have Frappe Framework v15.75.0 with Helpdesk v1.13.0 running smoothly; what’s still missing is a working Gmail channel. The project in Google Developer Console is ready, so your focus is to finish the OAuth handshake, validate the redirect URI inside Frappe, and confirm that both incoming and outgoing mail flow without errors.

Deliverable
• OAuth connection set up in Helpdesk and successfully authenticated with the existing Google project.
• Proof that tickets are being created from new emails and that replies are dispatched from Frappe without rejection or security warnings.

If you have real-world experience doing this inside Frappe, then only apply
